title: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

sense.text:
“All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes.” The world was made for Israel’s sake. So at its very core, when you get to the root of it, every agenda in this earth is about us. Everything on this planet is about us, and that is not vanity. The one thing that lets the nations put aside arms between them is Israel: the enemy of my enemy is my friend, and they are all friendly when it comes to pointing at us as their enemy.

That is why Israel itself is putting millions into influencing the AI learning models, why its AI funding jumped from 4.9 billion to 7.9 billion, and why Larry Ellison, the head of Oracle, the major investor when TikTok was forced to sell, is behind it. He is Amalek: he may say Judaism is a myth, but he is an avowed Zionist, one of the top donors to the Friends of the Israel Defense Forces, giving 26.6 million to subsidize the Israeli military, and saying they will do everything to support the country of Israel. What does Israel produce other than war, genocide, hatred, lies and propaganda? The US subsidizes it, through private donors and through bills that send it millions. They try to say anti-Zionism is anti-Semitism, but those are two different things. Zionism is perpetuating and maintaining the lie that the Israelis living there now are the Israelites: them that say they are Jews and are not, laying claim to a land, like criminals who took over a police station and dressed like cops. They know we use the internet, and they are strategically combating the teaching that IUIC puts out, the one camp that stays consistent on these topics while other camps debate whether Paul is true or argue a multiple wives doctrine. The word of the Most High is like fire and casts down all imaginations, so there is no time for complacency.

“And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.” One of the ways they devour us is with lies. This is mouth of the dragon doctrine, and it is not complicated: strategic salvos through the internet, because they cannot stand toe-to-toe with our teaching and research, so now they throw money behind it.

So be mindful of this kind of warfare. Download it and screenshot it, because a time is coming when you Google it and it will say something else, the way they keep trying to sway Wikipedia back. Outside resources are used, but the foundation of what we follow is the scriptures above all things: the one thing that cannot be disputed or corrupted, not anymore, because we are awake now.

“I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower”. We are supposed to always be looking, with our finger on the pulse of what is going on in the earth. If the earth is given into the hands of the wicked, any movement that happens, we have to be aware of. Filter out the BS and the distractions and hone in on what is relevant to us and why it matters. This is the wake-up call for Northern Kingdom, and a way for our Southern Kingdom brothers to reach them.

“And will watch to see what he will say unto me”: through the dispensation of the gospel and the manifestation of the spirit, the Lord is always looking to say something to us. He dealt directly with the prophets; now we do it through what we see in the scriptures, through that glass darkly, and what we can ascertain from things going on in the earth.

“Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.” Babylon is speaking plainly, but it is up to us to show when they are speaking plainly, to make the connections and tie them to the scriptures. They speak in euphemisms: security, stability, order, safety. When they use those words, they are ready to commit violence behind them. Trump changed the Department of Defense to the Department of War: war was in his heart. That is why he is loved here even as he angers us. He speaks plainly and lets it all be made known, and that wakes up those who sleep.

This is spiritual Babylon, spiritual Egypt, spiritual Sodom and Gomorrah, led by the United States of America: a global power alliance set up to suppress God’s truth and God’s kingdom, which is not going to happen. They blow up boats in the Caribbean and the Eastern Pacific and call them drug boats, yet a senator coming out of the classified briefing said there was no legal and no national security justification, no fentanyl coming to the United States from Venezuela, and the cocaine going to Europe. There were no drugs on those boats. They are killing fishermen.

Then Trump declared fentanyl a weapon of mass destruction, looking for a way to frame mischief by law and a means to go in, the same term they used for Iraq, where they found no weapons of mass destruction. They never cared about drugs: they flooded our neighborhoods with crack cocaine to fund their proxy wars off the books, as the Iran-Contra scandal proved. People forget, because a gift destroyeth the heart: as long as the economy is good, they go back to sleep.

Trump posted that Venezuela is surrounded by the largest armada ever assembled in the history of South America, which is a blockade, and that the shock to them will be like nothing they have seen, as they said shock and awe with Iraq, until they return all of the oil, land and other assets they previously stole. A sovereign country, with its own government and its own resources, somehow stole from the United States.

“If robbers by night”, “would they not have stolen till they had enough?” They are the world economic empire, the number one superpower on planet earth, the last empire that will be in the earth, and it is not enough for them. It is gluttony, the way that man and his spirit is. “If the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?” Even a thief leaves something behind. Not this one.

“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!” Now we are seeing it. He has the audacity to say, that’s our land, that’s our oil, like the stick-up kid in New York who walks up and says, yo, what you doing with my jacket, about the jacket you bought yourself. He rolls in that spirit.

He calls the Maduro government an illegitimate regime and calls them drug terrorists, human traffickers, murderers and kidnappers, when the biggest human trafficker in the history of planet earth is Esau. It’s Edom; he built his whole thing on it. Everything he calls them is what Esau is described as, living by the sword. And make no mistake: coming from the president of the United States, that post is a decree and a proclamation, with weight and power.

“Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.” These patterns of behavior have to be called out in the moment, to bring awareness to our people and bring it back home to the scriptures. Northern Kingdom needs to wake the hell up in their affliction: they are supposed to seek the Most High early, and this is that affliction going on right now.
“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked”: that is how they do things. Crafty counsel, secret counsels.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words”. There is always violence behind what they say. It is never about borders, security or safety, and it is never benevolent. They are not coming in to rescue the Venezuelan people, but they will frame it that way. Words are warfare: their arrows are bitter words, character assassination, laying a foundation.

See it with immigration. People were on board because he said he would only go after the criminals, the murderers and the rapists. But this man is crafty: if you are here illegally, by their rule of law that makes you a criminal. So he will scoop them all up, the child without documents, the father who isn’t documented. That is weaponizing words; read between the lines of how they speak. This man is evil as hell, and his spirit was created for that, raised up for that purpose the way Pharaoh was, so the Most High can take him down to show his power and his might.
“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect”: that is the crafty counsel, shooting in secret at the Most High’s hidden ones. “Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.”

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily”. When they commune, they are talking to each other about the plan and how to keep perpetuating it, and it covers every layer: the Zionist movement giving money to fund it, and wealthy men saying they will throw heavy dollars against anybody who goes against Zionism.

“They say, Who shall see them?” You are seeing them in these actions. These scriptures don’t fit just one act; we focus on patterns of behavior. That is how we identify not only who we are as tribes, but chiefly Esau, Edom and the other nations in these last days.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds!” They say, who seeth me? Upon their beds means they are protected, insulated from consequence. They know nobody can touch them, as Trump said in his first term that he could kill somebody on Fifth Avenue and nothing would be done to him. Babylon speaking plainly.

“When the morning is light, they practise it”: they do it in the daylight through institutions, legalese and laws. They fund Israel through nonprofits and directly, and through the 900 billion dollar bill everybody rejoiced over, with billions inside it for Israel, Ukraine and other places, in stacks of pages nobody reads, the president signing the last page.

“Because it is in the power of their hand”: God made them for that. They are the vessels of wrath fitted for destruction, and that fitted for destruction part is the hope we have. Though it angers us, all that wrath will be paid back to them double.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence”: oil fields, iron ore fields, precious mineral fields, rare earth fields, agricultural fields. “And houses, and take them away”: he didn’t only say oil, he said, that’s our land. “So they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage”: his house, his land, and under the Zionist agenda even his identity, them that say they are Jews and are not.

They covet what they want in Venezuela: the lineup of warships, the seizure of the oil tanker they say was headed for China. They ask whether it is legal because they need the people’s support behind it, and if it isn’t, they weaponize the legal system. Sanctions, asset seizures, blockades: we think violence has to be bloodshed, but all of that is violence too, economic violence. Whether you take a man out by the neck or frame a law to oppress him in his house, his heritage and his land, it is still violent.

precepts.why:
Micah says it is in the power of their hand; Luke shows who put it there. “And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” This is when he showed Christ all the mountains and the cities. To whomsoever I will, I give it.

So who gave them their power? Who are the ministers of Satan? Babylon the great, Esau, what the world ignorantly calls the white man. Even those words, white and black, are arrows: nobody is black like their shirt. There is power in words, and that is why God says he will use his word against them. It is in their power to do these things because the devil gave it to them.

“Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” This is how the whole system was designed. The constitution was not framed for us; there was three-fifths of a man. It was based on Roman and Greek democracy, as you read in the Maccabees, and even then we were not part of it. It was meant to frame things to keep them in power.

The Supreme Court is the final say on what the founders of the country intended, the way the scripture calls us judges, teachers and prophets, to show that scriptures that seem old are still relevant from generation to generation; they do that with Esau’s constitution. The three branches, the lawsuits, the executive orders: all of it is words and framing mischief to benefit them. It is a system we should not take part in. Our salvation is not in it.

It is present and current. In a six to three ruling on the shadow docket, behind closed doors, the court gave ICE the legal cover to stop and detain people on appearance, language, accent or workplace: racial profiling on a massive scale, aimed at Northern Kingdom here, while the same is done to African countries. Citizens are not required to carry proof of citizenship, and a license is not enough, so if you are Northern Kingdom and fit the profile, carry your passport or a passport card. That is framing mischief by law.

sense.text:
“For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie”. Before the angels holding the four winds let it go, so that redemption can come, there will be moments of acceleration. For our sakes the days are shortened: not only the earth spinning faster, but like a woman with contractions, the prophetic events that push things forward come quicker. When Trump’s post went to the deacons and bishops, the answer came back: good, he is hastening the return of Christ. That is how to understand this verse, and the shortening of days. Unless you are watching and knowing, you miss that these are milestones taking us closer to the end.

“Though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.” You won’t know the appointed time; you have to wait for it. We do not sleep as others do; we are of the day, so we watch. Nobody knows the hour or the day; what we look for are the patterns of behavior that show the days being shortened. It may tarry a little while, but steps have been made, like the GPS counting down the minutes, like the clock hand in Ezra.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. That goes with what we read in Luke, in Micah and in Psalm 64: it is in his spirit, it is in the power of his hand, and his words are arrows and weapons.

“He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”. Give us our lands, give us our assets: they are always meddling in world affairs. Look at the US interventions in Latin America, and before them the banana wars, corporate espionage backed by the US government when agriculture was the resource they wanted. Interventions is a nice word for not keeping at home. And that is only here: there are the bases all over the world, Puerto Rico, Guam, the US Virgin Islands. The United States is far larger than the cutout map they show you. Even America First is BS: everything is done on a global scale, not to protect the people but to maintain their dominance.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”. He cannot be satisfied; he is insatiable. That is the gluttony of Obadiah: robbers would have taken only what they needed. Not this man. Not this spirit.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”. That goes with Micah 2 and Luke 4:6. No leader is going to rise up and combat what they have done, and there is no winning in their sandbox and their politics: only Christ can save us from this. While Trump threatens to bomb Maduro for trafficking drugs, he pardons a former president of Honduras who was tried and convicted of running one of the largest cartels there, because the special interest phone call came. It was never about drugs; now it is, you took our land and our oil. Economics is a big part of how they keep their rule.

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”: the real judges are the Israelites. “If not, where, and who is he?” If it is not this man, who is it? Look at their conferences and governments, the United Nations, the G8, the economic forums. When the prophecies were revealed to the forefathers, they were seeing visions of rooms like that: diverse nations together, Israel not represented, commiserating about world domination. That is how they knew the nations took crafty counsel together.

precepts.why:
The haters rarely come against the prophetic teaching, because they are unequipped. Like the sword only King Arthur could pull, they can’t grasp it; it is not given to them. “And they sung as it were a new song before the throne”, “and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.”

It is given only to the 144,000 to bring these things out, understand them and make them plain for the people: the judges whose faces the wicked covers. Redeemed from the earth.

sense.text:
They take every approach: drug dealers, terrorists, traffickers, and now weapons of mass destruction. Once that is said, there is no more moral debate about the people and the economy; extraordinary measures become acceptable, the appetite for war and bombing is there, and they can take preemptive action. It is the pattern of Iraq: weapons of mass destruction, sanctions, invasion, regime change, then restructuring the flow of the resources. In Venezuela: weapons of mass destruction language, sanctions, blockade threats, regime denial, and now claiming the resources. The only difference is that in Iraq the motive was denied; here he plainly says he wants the oil, the land and the resources.

They call Maduro an existential threat as they called Saddam Hussein a threat; chemical weapons then, fentanyl now; Al-Qaeda then, the Al-Qaeda of our hemisphere now; shock and awe; the largest oil reserves in the world; America First meaning the Americas first, because South America has America in its name, so it is theirs. The same wording and structure: the patterns.

“Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace”. That is the interventions, what they did through the School of the Americas, now called WHINSEC: the proxy wars where they put up and prop up leaders who support their agenda. The minute you don’t, everything gone over in this class is what they do to you and call you, and they take you down. “Finally, that they were greatly exalted”: play ball with them and you reap the benefits. If not, they demonize you.

Whenever a government really tries to be for the people, they call it socialism and communism. Fidel was framed as a communist, but he gave houses to every citizen in Cuba. In Cuba the people said, we don’t pay rent, though under the blockade the food is rationed and the shelves are bare every day. Those are the hard decisions a sanctioned government has to make to keep its people alive and fed. Chavez and Maduro tried to do the same.

“Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees”. What Trump posted is a decree, and it is unrighteous: Venezuela is a sovereign nation, and nothing was stolen. Venezuela never took US land; its only land dispute was with Guyana. In 1976 Venezuela nationalized its oil and took control of its own reserves, and the foreign companies, Exxon, Gulf, Shell, were compensated under Venezuelan law. That is not theft and not violent; it was legal and common, as Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Iran did. The United States bought Venezuelan oil for decades, and CITGO is Venezuelan owned; under Chavez, when gas prices were high, CITGO sold gas cheaper in the hood to blacks and Hispanics. Venezuela defaulted on debts only because the sanctions were set up to make it default, like the executives in Brewster’s Millions, and then the default was the justification for more sanctions. That is violent, crazy framing mischief by law.

“And that write grievousness which they have prescribed”. He writes all the things Venezuela allegedly did, yet they prescribed the very mechanisms that put Venezuela and every other country where they are. The reason so many migrate here is what the US did in our countries in Latin America: they destroyed the economies, raped the resources and robbed the heritage, and then they curse them as the third world countries they made them. That is the prescription, and then they write a grievance about what they did.

The Roosevelt Corollary was that kind of decree. Behind the Monroe Doctrine, their declaration to Britain, Spain, Portugal and France to stay the hell out of the Western Hemisphere, the Roosevelt Corollary decreed that they now have the authority to be the police of the Western Hemisphere. That is how they feel justified today to shoot down the boats and put their nose into any of these countries.

“To turn aside the needy from judgment”: we are that needy. “And to take away the right from the poor of my people”: the rights of the oil and the rights of the land. There is no reason a country with black gold, the largest oil reserves on planet earth, the tribe of Asher, should be poor and broke: cycling the power because it can’t maintain the grid, water on certain days, food rationed, women with degrees, doctors and teachers, prostituting themselves to feed their families. It gets uncomfortable fighting a revolution; sacrifices have to be made, and many won’t endure it, as we begged in the wilderness to go back to Egypt for the onions and leeks. The writing is on the wall: there will be regime change, and the bulk of the people will rejoice, because a gift destroyeth the heart, the illusion of inclusion, while their home and heritage are taken.

“That widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!” They rob them of their resources and everything else. They even devalue the oil, saying Venezuela’s heavy, high-sulfur crude is bad and hard to refine so they can get it for less, when all the oil in the Western Hemisphere is heavy crude and the Gulf Coast refiners are hungry for it because it is more profitable to process. The oil companies are in the ear of the senators, the congressmen and the president for their boom. It is never enough.

“Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations”. The laws, statutes and commandments, everything written in the scripture: this is our wisdom. “Which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.” Partly that happened under Solomon, when they said he was the wisest there is, but the full fulfillment is in the kingdom of heaven. Right now they don’t call us that; they call us rebellious, because we mess up their devices.

“And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law”. All of it is righteous, the economics too. Every initiative the leadership puts forth is based on what the scripture says: the fundraising, the different offices, so the body can be self-sustaining. But many of us, raised in this environment, conduct business like Esau: Israelite businesses that market to the body and make money off the body, and never come back to say, my pockets are filled, I want to give back.

precepts.why:
“Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.” If you get blessed, it is to have to give to him that needeth. That is how it is set up in Acts 2 and Acts 4: you lay it at the feet of the leadership, and the leadership distributes as there is need. Some have cutthroat tactics with no respect at all, moving the same way the nations do; it would behoove those who say they are businessmen to read how economics in Israel functioned.

The forgiving of debt every seven years was so that debt does not pass from generation to generation. There was no usury, no interest, and it was forgiven so the debt would not continue and perpetuate. Today what many leave behind is debt.

sense.text:
“He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.” That spirit was in Israel; it is spoken to us here, chiefly the Northern Kingdom, with Judah in the mix. But where did we learn it? From the other nations. The law shows how we handled economics among ourselves, and it was not that. We took on their customs, not only their lewdness and fornications but having no compassion for our own people.

Usury was for the other nations: we lent to them and charged them interest, but among ourselves it was different. You still made a profit, but always with the intent of communal wealth, leaving the corners of the field, looking out for each other, so generations would not be stuck. Instead we take up the insatiable appetite and have to have every last drop. Not so with God.

precepts.why:
That is why this was spoken against us: mixed among the nations, we learned it from them. Nehemiah had to curse out the merchants of the other nations who came on the sabbath, and they came because we were breaking the law buying it. “When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great”: that is messing with the scales, the balances of deceit of Hosea 12. We shouldn’t have it, but now you see who really does.

“And falsifying the balances by deceit”: they do it now with the oil, calling it too heavy when it is more profitable than anything else. And with mortgages: interest is designed to keep you in debt and broke, front-loaded so the first years go mostly to interest. On a 300,000 dollar house at five percent, a 15-year loan pays about 105,000 in interest and a 30-year about 250,800, and the 50-year mortgage Trump offers, instead of fixing the economy, adds about 476,000, a debt you leave to your wife and kids. Owning is still better than renting your whole life, but the American dream is an American nightmare. If our economics were set up, we would lend and not charge each other. That is the wicked principle of deceitful scales on a broad scale, and Edom does it first and excels at it.

sense.text: “Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God”. The Israelis are chief in saying that now, but all of Edom puts themselves there because of the white false image of Cesare Borgia: God is white, all the angels are white, all the prophets are white. “In the midst of the seas”: in the midst of all the nations. “Though thou set thine heart as the heart of God”: they operate in the earth as though they control everything, because it has been given into their hand for a dispensation of time, as Jerusalem is trodden down until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”. They have figured out how to manipulate all these laws to get what they want. Trump is going to get that oil and that land, and put in that freaking harlot of an opposition leader, Machado, who won the peace prize and is saying, come and get everything.

“With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures”. We like to say they are dumb, but we are dumb because we learn from them. They put us where a gift destroys the heart and our eyes aren’t open, and most of us don’t have the scriptures. Once you have the scriptures, you are enlightened.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”. That traffic goes into slavery and the trading of the souls of men, and also into all the commerce and merchandise, as Revelation 18 lists the gold and precious things and then the souls of men. “And thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches”. These are the real weapons of mass destruction they use.

precepts.why:
Read to show that the traffic chiefly deals with people. “Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men”: slavery. Us. “And vessels of brass in thy market”: all the other things, the oils, jewels and precious metals.

Then back to 28:5: “By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches”. He got rich trading us.

sense.text:
The End of Poverty shows it: poverty is not an accident. Sub-Saharan Africa pays 25,000 dollars every minute to northern creditors, the south financing the north, and the United States, with less than five percent of the world’s population, consumes over 25 percent of its resources. The system is a failure only for the side being oppressed; for the man of sin, Babylon the Great, it is an absolute success. From Africa to Latin America it is the same afflictions. The Lord made the earth sustainable for all life on it; don’t let them fool you with the population talk. He is insatiable, and all the prophecies about him are true.

“The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together”. A narrow mind thinks only of the fields, but look at the economic and resource oppression on the continents where we live: both kingdoms, twelve tribes, suffering the same afflictions. The same anger we feel at the exploitation of Africa we should feel at what is done to the so-called Latinos, the Northern Kingdom in Latin America. For those who say we don’t fit the curses, here is more mud in your eye. We are yet this day in our captivity. If they lost Africa and Latin America, the rest of the world could not sustain itself. There are 300 million here, but over 500 million in Latin America, nearly a billion with the Caribbean and Central America. We look through the narrow scope of America, but the Lord put us here to be fed by the breast of Babylon so that we can do something about it.

“And all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” Because of the resources in our lands. If they could genocide us off the face of the earth and move in themselves, they would. Only by God’s mercies does a remnant survive. We don’t die, we multiply, like the sand of the sea and the stars.

“Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause”. Our Redeemer is Christ. Even though all this is so, he is strong and will thoroughly plead, and he pleads with his sword. “That he may give rest to the land”: there were laws to let the soil rest, but they deplete the topsoil, because all they do is take. “And disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon”: he names Babylon. We did not stay free; we have a Redeemer, so this is for another time. Somebody will say it was fulfilled back then. It wasn’t. There is still more to be done.

“But this is a people robbed and spoiled”. Robbed and spoiled is the oppression we read in Micah. Robbed goes to our identity: cut off, deprived, destitute, dispossessed. Not living as the sons of God, we accept what they call us, Gentiles and less than nothing, and we become impoverished, left without hope, without a redeemer, without access to our own resources, stripped and found wanting. Spoiled is where they take the resources: severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value, marred or ruined.

“They are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” That is why our Redeemer must come and do it. Notice all the re- words that go with Israel: redeemed, restored, redemption. For the dummies who think the covenant passed on to strangers or some foreign nation, the morons buying into those philosophies: our people have got to wake up.

precepts.why:
Spoiled means reduced in value. We are the sons of God, the greatest people the Lord ever created; he made the whole earth and everything in it for us. Is that what we reap now? No. “There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.” Folly set in great dignity is the foolish things, the vessels of wrath. The rich sitting in low place are the real rich: in poverty and in suffering, yet rich.

“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” Those who were meant to serve us sit in authority and high value, and the princes walk as servants. If that is not the visual for spoiled, nothing is. Read Isaiah 42:22 again with that sense: a people robbed and spoiled.

sense.text:
Babylon did get judgment, but not as fully as the scripture says. It faded over time as the Medo-Persians and the Greeks went over them, but it never really went away. This is spiritual Babylon: somebody would take up that mantle and move that way. The Bible follows behavior patterns to identify the nations, because in these last days they would carry other names as part of their crafty counsel to hide who they are. His judgment is like a ring: some of the prophecy happened in those times, but much of it was reserved for another time.

“A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon”. The sword is the pleading of verse 34. The Chaldeans are the elite of the Babylonians, but the sword is upon all the inhabitants of Babylon, not only the upper echelon, including the Israelites that don’t repent. “And upon her princes, and upon her wise men.”

“A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots”: on their tanks and planes. “And upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her”: the United States is the great melting pot, thick clay heaped upon itself with all types of nations. “A sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.” What they did to us will happen to them. And robbed is not only things taken back, because it is not robbery when what is ours is redeemed: they will be devalued, as the servants on horses in Ecclesiastes 10.

“For it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.” From the money to the way they set up DC to their Christianity to all the symbolism in their politics: all graven images. Politics is a religion too, as in 1 Maccabees 1. Mad upon their idols means crazy for them: the American flag, Americanism. This is the only country that waves its flags around all the time.

“Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there”. Once the smoke and smolder of the nuclear destruction is there, only wild beasts will be able to dwell there. “It shall be no more inhabited for ever”: that did not happen to the physical Babylon of that time. It is for a time to come, and it is the Redeemer who does it.

“As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof”. That is the key point: does Sodom and Gomorrah exist after that? No. The ultimate destruction will be as Sodom and Gomorrah. Either the Bible is lying and the prophecy didn’t come true, or it is speaking of something else, for a different time.

precepts.why:
In 34 the Redeemer is strong and will thoroughly plead their cause, and then he speaks of the sword. Pleading is not, please give this back to my people. “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”.

Now you can visualize the sword upon the Chaldeans in Jeremiah 50:35: the judgment that comes upon Babylon.

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” The glory of kingdoms tells you who this is. “It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation”: the same words as Jeremiah 50, for a different time.

sense.text:
Look at the big stick picture from the 1920s: Santo Domingo, Cuba, Venezuela, Panama, Mexico, the Caribbean Sea, with the debt collector, the sheriff, the receiver and the embargo. The same ideology they have today with the largest armada parked off Venezuela, and it makes Habakkuk 2 more visual.

“Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!” That is what we just read in the prophecy of the mingled people, the other nations, the neighbour cities.
“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee”, as Revelation 18 and other verses speak of. “And thou shalt be for booties unto them”.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”. The remnant of Israel will have that glory and that honor. He spoiled many nations: financial domination, systemic extraction of resources, imperial dominance without owning the places, never saying you are part of us but acting as the owners. And the remnant will spoil him: what the scripture says they will receive. Reciprocity. It is inevitable.

precepts.why: “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.” That is the reciprocity of Habakkuk 2:8. She will be rewarded for what she did, filled to her double.

sense.text: We cannot forget that we are also reaping what we have sown, especially Northern Kingdom. Just as there is prophecy for Babylon that great city and the other nations, this is prophecy for us, and they are the ministers of evil unto us for the evil we have done. “Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God”: because we sought after the other nations and their ideals and made deals with them. Look at it in modern times. We reap what we sow.
“But Ephraim shall return to Egypt”: to captivity. “And they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.” That is servitude, dependence, our resources consumed by others.

precepts.why: “The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up”. All the oil, the land, the assets they say we stole from them and want back. “And thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway”. Others eat our labor: that is what The End of Poverty is about.

sense.text:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Too often the sense we give this scripture is United States based. When we go to these other countries and see what is happening in Venezuela and Cuba anytime resources are involved, the sense has to be given this way, because they are fully aware of the robbing of their resources.

Being here, being American, we can’t fathom want of all things. It is not speaking of any individual but of the curse upon our people and our tribes. That is why this verse is so profound: chains don’t have to be chains no more.

precepts.why:
Why did they target these things specifically? The scripture says what the chief things in life are. “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” When you target those things, you dehumanize people: you take away the principal things needful for life and dignity. That is why they will never let the resources in what they call their backyard be in the control of the people who own them. They must maintain that dominance. Same here, same in Africa.

“All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented, as Hosea 9 shows, because we lived evil, all these things are turned over to the ungodly, and we will not reclaim them until the Redeemer comes. In that process we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

“The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” It is violence when they do that. You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb, a bullet; but defraud them of the principal things and you are a man of blood. “He that taketh away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” As the brother in the documentary said, I work all day and still have nothing to go home to eat.

“When one buildeth, and another pulleth down, what profit have they then but labour?” Their only profit is labor. Their necks are under persecution; that is all that is left to them.

sense.text: “Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.” They oppress a man in his house, even a man in his heritage.

“We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. This is not just for that time there, whatever they say about that was then, get over it.
“Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.” As we just read, the only reward we have is labor.

“We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread”, as in Hosea 9. We have given power, authority and sovereignty over our resources to Egypt and Assyria: Babylon the Great, the United States and the other nations. China is working its way into Latin America, which is why Trump is getting more aggressive there now.

“Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.” If the Monroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary and the big stick don’t apply to Northern Kingdom with that verse, nothing does. We are still paying for the sins of our forefathers, bearing the brunt of it to this very day under all this oppression and economic violence.

“Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.” That is Ecclesiastes 10:7, the servants upon horses. It is not chattel slavery anymore; we are under economic captivity, subject to payments. At its base that is paying taxes, which is true, as Christ spoke of who is free when kings take tribute, but it is so much broader than that.

precepts.why:
“Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where thou hast scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers”. Subject to payments according to the iniquities of our fathers: our fathers have sinned and are not, and we have borne their iniquities. “Which departed from the Lord our God”: that is the key.

This is the compassion we must have to push this out to our people and speak to it properly: reach in, touch their soul, make it alive. Babylon is speaking plainly. Why ain’t we? We have got to rise up and fight that.

sense.text: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”: this is once Christ comes to redeem us. We read the same thing in Isaiah, and now in Revelation. The Bible is repetitive and it supports itself.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: that is Bretton Woods. In July 1944, with Europe in ruins, 44 allied nations met at Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, and America, its industry intact, its military dominant, holding 70 percent of the world’s gold, made the US dollar the reserve currency, every other currency pegged to it and gold at 35 dollars an ounce. Only America could create dollars; every other nation had to earn them. Out of it came the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the World Bank Group and the IMF, all headquartered in Washington DC. Mystery, Babylon the great is no longer a mystery: all the power was centralized here. They are the banker in Monopoly. Their stated mission to reduce poverty around the world is a lie.

In August 1971 Nixon suspended convertibility to gold, a default with no vote and no negotiation, yet trade, oil and global debt stayed in dollars, and instead of collapsing it grew more powerful. The dollar became a gatekeeper, a weapon and the condition of participation. That is the real weapon of mass destruction. 1944 established their economic might, and in 1945, when they dropped the bomb and did miracles in the sight of the nations, they put the big stick behind it.

So if America collapses, all of them collapse. It is a covenant with death the other nations made too, and their talk against each other is BS and posturing. America can’t fail until God makes it fail. That is why a Chavez or a Maduro, who gave land and homes back to the people, made colleges free and redistributed the wealth, applying biblical economics without the Bible, gets sanctioned, couped and called illegitimate, as was done to Gaddafi when he tried to put Africa under one currency. The system is rigged: if you don’t play by it, you can’t make money, no matter what resources you have.

“And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.” They married themselves to the success of America; it behooves them that she keeps her dominance.

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Because of what we read in Hosea and in Lamentations, we are in these situations, so we must come out of her and not partake of those things.

Admirable as those revolutions are, without the scriptures they will not come to fruition; we need our Redeemer to take us out. The power given into our hand is to repent. We don’t attack any powers or governments; the scripture says obey the powers that be. But we build back and rehearse those righteous acts: not only the dietary law and the fringes, but building that community and that economy with each other.
“Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works”: assured reciprocity. That is the recompense.

“For she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.” Too often we think of antiquated trade, but she still dominates, as she did in her other iterations as the Greeks and the Romans.

“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”, because they are all tied to her: what are we going to do now? They won’t have to worry about that anymore, because from that point on, it is our time.

“The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls”: they get it from Africa, from Latin America, from wherever our people are. “And slaves, and souls of men”: the trafficking. The horses and chariots in modern times are the weapons they sell to the other countries, in US dollars. They have complete authority and control, not only by the threat of their warfare but because they run the money. But the Lord is going to give them judgment, just as we read.
